taskTitle: Design a two-stage Miller op amp
circuit:
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Two-stage Miller-compensated CMOS operational amplifier
* Sky130 1.8 V core devices + ideal R/C.  Interface: 50 uA reference forced
* into `iref`, 0.9 V input common mode, 1 pF load on `vout`.
*
* Topology
*   Stage 1 : NMOS-input folded cascode.  Folding is what makes the 0.9 V
*             common mode work on a 1.62 V supply: the input-pair drains sit
*             near vdd (nx/ny ~ 1.22 V) instead of being pinned to whatever
*             gate voltage stage 2 needs, so the closed-loop range is set by
*             the output stage rather than by the first-stage load.  It also
*             supplies almost all of the loop gain and holds both input drains
*             at the same potential, which keeps the systematic offset (and
*             hence the unity-feedback tracking error) in the sub-mV range
*             even when the tail leaves saturation at low input common mode.
*   Stage 2 : NMOS common source (M11) with a PMOS current-source load (M12).
*             NMOS drive is essential here - sky130 PMOS gm/Id is roughly half
*             that of NMOS, so a PMOS output device could not reach the ~5 mS
*             needed to place the second pole above the unity-gain frequency
*             within the 2 mW budget.
*   Comp    : Miller capacitor CC with series nulling resistor RZ.  RZ is set
*             above 1/gm11 so the compensation zero is always in the left half
*             plane over process/temperature, adding phase lead near crossover
*             instead of the usual right-half-plane lag.
*
* Device-choice notes
*   pfet_01v8 has |Vth| ~ 1.0 V in this PDK and is unusable for headroom, so
*   every PMOS is pfet_01v8_lvt (|Vth| ~ 0.43 V).  nfet_01v8_lvt has markedly
*   lower flicker noise than nfet_01v8, so it is used for the input pair, the
*   folded-cascode load mirror (M9/M10) and the output driver - the three
*   dominant noise contributors.  Plain nfet_01v8 is kept for the reference
*   and tail mirrors, where its higher Vth costs nothing.
*
* Nominal operating point (tt, 1.8 V, 27 C)
*   tail 212 uA, folded branches 170 uA each, cascode/mirror 64 uA,
*   stage 2 316 uA, bias chain 70 uA; total 727 uA -> 1.31 mW.
*   gm1 1.92 mS, gm11 4.92 mS; nx 1.22 V, na 0.65 V, n1 0.61 V.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---------------- bias generation ----------------
* The testbench forces 50 uA into `iref`; MB0 sinks it and sets the NMOS
* mirror rail.  MB1 turns a 20 uA copy into the PMOS gate rail `pb`, and RPCB
* drops a supply- and process-independent ~0.35 V from it to make the PMOS
* cascode rail `pcb`.  A resistor rather than a stacked diode keeps this
* branch out of triode at ss / 1.62 V / -40 C, where a two-diode stack starves
* and collapses the folded-cascode bias.  CPB/CPCB tie both rails to vdd at
* high frequency so the PMOS sources keep a constant Vsg and supply ripple is
* not converted into signal current.
XMB0    iref   iref   vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XMBS    pcb    iref   vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMB1    pb     pb     vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5.6 nf=1
RPCB    pb     pcb    17500
CPB     pb     vdd    1e-12
CPCB    pcb    vdd    5e-13

* ---------------- stage 1: folded cascode ----------------
* MT sets the 212 uA tail.  M3/M4 each source 170 uA, leaving 64 uA to fold
* through the PMOS cascodes M5/M6 into the M9/M10 mirror.  Sizing M3/M4 above
* half the tail keeps both fold branches conducting under full differential
* overdrive, which is what sets the positive slew rate, (2*I_M3 - I_tail)/CC.
XMT     ntail  iref   vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=88 nf=14
XM1     nx     vinn   ntail  vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=60 nf=10
XM2     ny     vinp   ntail  vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=60 nf=10
XM3     nx     pb     vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=50 nf=8
XM4     ny     pb     vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=50 nf=8
XM5     na     pcb    nx     vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=24 nf=4
XM6     n1     pcb    ny     vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=24 nf=4
XM9     na     na     vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XM10    n1     na     vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2

* ---------------- stage 2 ----------------
* The short-channel LVT driver keeps the stage-2 input capacitance near 100 fF
* so the Miller pole split is not spoiled; the long-channel PMOS load holds
* the stage gain up and its low Vdsat preserves the output swing.
XM11    vout   n1     vss    vss    sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=70 nf=11
XM12    vout   pb     vdd    vdd    sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=90 nf=14

* ---------------- Miller compensation ----------------
* RZ*gm11 ~ 3.4 at tt: the zero stays in the left half plane at every corner,
* and far enough above crossover that the loop keeps a single clean 0 dB
* crossing with no gain re-entry above unity.
RZ      n1     ncz    700
CC      ncz    vout   9e-13

.ends two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a two-stage Miller op amp
circuit:
* Two-stage Miller-compensated CMOS operational amplifier (Sky130 1.8 V core).
*
* Topology
*   Stage 1  NMOS differential pair XM1/XM2 on the NMOS tail source XM5,
*            loaded by the PMOS current mirror XM3/XM4.  vinp drives the
*            mirror-output side so the vinp -> vout path is non-inverting.
*            The pair is wide and biased in moderate inversion so its Vgs
*            stays small: that keeps the tail device saturated at 1.62 V with
*            a 0.9 V input common mode (which is what sets CMRR and PSRR) and
*            keeps the input-referred flicker noise low.
*   Stage 2  PMOS common source XM6 with the NMOS current sink XM7.  XM6 is
*            kept short so its gate capacitance stays well below the 1 pF
*            load, which places the non-dominant pole high.  Its current
*            density is matched to XM3/XM4 so Vsg6 = Vsg3 and the systematic
*            offset is nulled (< 0.4 mV over all corners).
*   Comp.    Miller capacitor CC with series nulling resistor RZ.  RZ > 1/gm6
*            moves the feed-forward zero into the left half plane, where it
*            adds phase lead just above the crossover; the loop magnitude
*            still falls monotonically through 0 dB and settles about 10 dB
*            below unity at high frequency.
*
* Bias      Every branch current is mirrored from the external 50 uA
*           reference forced into pin iref: 6x for the 300 uA tail, 10x for
*           the 500 uA output stage.  The NMOS mirror is run at a low current
*           density (L = 1 um) for a small Vdsat and a high output resistance.
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ---- bias: iref sinks the 50 uA reference and sets the NMOS gate rail ------
XMB0 iref  iref  vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=16.67 nf=3
* ---- first stage: 300 uA tail, 150 uA per side ----------------------------
XM5  ntail iref  vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=100.0 nf=20
XM1  n3    vinn  ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=180 nf=36
XM2  n1    vinp  ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=180 nf=36
XM3  n3    n3    vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=60.0 nf=12
XM4  n1    n3    vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=60.0 nf=12
* ---- second stage: 500 uA -------------------------------------------------
XM6  vout  n1    vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=157.79 nf=32
XM7  vout  iref  vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=166.67 nf=33
* ---- miller compensation --------------------------------------------------
RZ   n1    nz    600
CC   nz    vout  1.45p
.ends two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a two-stage Miller op amp
circuit:
* =====================================================================
* two_stage_miller_opamp -- Sky130 1.8 V core CMOS, single ended
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Topology
*   Stage 1 : NMOS differential pair (XM1/XM2) on an NMOS tail current
*             source (XM8), loaded by a PMOS current mirror (XM3/XM4).
*   Stage 2 : PMOS common-source driver (XM6) with an NMOS current-sink
*             load (XM7).
*   Comp.   : Miller capacitor CC from vout back to the stage-1 output
*             n1, in series with the nulling resistor RZ.  RZ moves the
*             feedforward zero into the left half plane just above the
*             crossover, where it partly cancels the output pole.
*   Bias    : the testbench forces 50 uA from vdd into iref.  XM0 is the
*             diode that turns it into a gate voltage; XM8 and XM7 are
*             ratioed copies (tail ~6.4x, output sink ~7.3x).  Every
*             branch current is therefore referred to the ideal 50 uA
*             reference and is nearly PVT independent.
*
* Device choices
*   The regular pfet_01v8 is used for the mirror load and the output
*   driver: around L = 0.4..0.5 um its Early voltage is roughly 3.5x
*   that of the _lvt flavour, which is what buys the >65 dB worst-case
*   loop gain.  Its higher |Vth| puts the stage-1 drains near vdd-1.12 V,
*   yet the unity-feedback tracking range still exceeds 1.0 Vpp because
*   the low-input side degrades only gradually.
*   Regular (non-lvt) nfets are used for the pair so that their higher
*   Vth keeps the stage-1 drains inside the input common-mode range.
*
* Matching / offset
*   XM6 and XM3/XM4 run at the same |Vgs| and W6/W3 is set to I7/I3, so
*   n1 sits at the same potential as the mirror diode node nd.  The pair
*   stays balanced, the systematic offset is ~0.1 mV, and that in turn
*   preserves the mirror's common-mode cancellation (CMRR) and keeps the
*   closed-loop static settling error far inside 2 mV.
* =====================================================================
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ---- bias mirror (50 uA reference forced into iref) ----
XM0   iref iref vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=21 nf=10
XM8   tail iref vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=134.4 nf=67
XM7   vout iref vss  vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=154.1 nf=77
* ---- stage 1: NMOS pair with PMOS mirror load ----
XM1   nd   vinn tail vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.65 w=108 nf=54
XM2   n1   vinp tail vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.65 w=108 nf=54
XM3   nd   nd   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=62.4 nf=31
XM4   n1   nd   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=62.4 nf=31
* ---- stage 2: PMOS common source with NMOS sink ----
XM6   vout n1   vdd  vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=147.706 nf=74
* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistor ----
RZ    n1   nz   600
CC    nz   vout 1.2p
.ends two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a two-stage Miller op amp
circuit:
* Two-stage Miller-compensated CMOS op amp (Sky130 1.8 V core devices only).
*
* Stage 1: NMOS-input folded cascode. PMOS current sources (M3/M4) and PMOS
*          cascodes (M5/M6) fold the input-pair current into an NMOS current
*          mirror (M7/M8); single-ended output at n1.
* Stage 2: NMOS common-source (M11) with PMOS current-source load (M12).
* Compensation: Miller capacitor CC with series nulling resistor RZ (LHP zero).
* Bias: all currents derive from the 50 uA reference sunk by diode XMB1. The
*       tail (XM0) and the stage-1 PMOS bias sink (XMB2) are wider copies of
*       XMB1 with source degeneration, so their currents rise with temperature
*       (Delta-VGS/R). This offsets the 1/T drop of the weak-inversion input
*       pair gm and keeps the unity-gain bandwidth nearly flat over -40..125 C.
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ---------------- bias ----------------
* 50 uA reference into diode-connected NMOS
XMB1 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=25 nf=5
* NMOS sinks feeding the PMOS bias diodes (XMB2 degenerated, see above)
XMB2 vbp iref s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
R2 s2 vss 3000
XMB3 vbo iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMB4 vbc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=5 nf=1
* PMOS diodes: stage-1 current sources, stage-2 load, cascode gate bias
XMBP vbp vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=2
XMBO vbo vbo vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XMBC vbc vbc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1.5 nf=1
* ---------------- stage 1 ----------------
* Tail current source (degenerated, see above)
XM0 tail iref s0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=400 nf=80
R0 s0 vss 300
* Input pair (vinp drives the output-side branch)
XM1 f1 vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=32
XM2 f2 vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=32
* PMOS current sources at the fold nodes
XM3 f1 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=15
XM4 f2 vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=60 nf=15
* PMOS cascodes
XM5 n3 vbc f1 f1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=12 nf=3
XM6 n1 vbc f2 f2 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=12 nf=3
* NMOS current-mirror load (long L, strong inversion for low flicker noise)
XM7 n3 n3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XM8 n1 n3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
* ---------------- stage 2 ----------------
XM11 vout n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.18 w=96 nf=24
XM12 vout vbo vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=40
* ---------------- compensation ----------------
RZ n1 nc 750
CC nc vout 1.1p
.ends two_stage_miller_opamp

taskTitle: Design a two-stage Miller op amp
circuit:
* Two-stage Miller-compensated CMOS op amp (Sky130 1.8 V core devices).
*
* Stage 1: low-flicker NMOS lvt differential pair folded into PMOS lvt
*          cascodes, with a self-biased NMOS cascode current-mirror load
*          (differential-to-single-ended conversion, output node o2).
*          The NMOS pair keeps tail headroom at 1.62 V; the folded load
*          lets o2 sit at an NMOS Vgs so it can drive a fast NMOS stage 2.
* Stage 2: NMOS common-source driver with PMOS current-source load.
* Compensation: Miller capacitor CC with series resistor RZ (LHP zero).
*
* Nominal currents: 50 uA reference, 2 x 12.5 uA bias branches,
* ~210 uA tail (~105 uA per input device), ~140 uA per folding source
* (~35 uA per cascode branch), ~400 uA output stage.
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* Bias. The 50 uA reference enters an NMOS diode. One NMOS sink feeds the
* PMOS current-source bias diode (pb). Another feeds a PMOS lvt diode plus
* series resistor RPC; that sets the PMOS cascode gate (pc) so the folding
* nodes sit about I*RPC below the rail.
XMB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
XMB1 pb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMBP pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XMB2 pc iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
RPC pd pc 28k
XMBC pd pd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=5 nf=1
* Stage 1: tail, input pair, folding current sources, PMOS cascodes
XM0 tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=176 nf=44
XM1 f1 vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=80 nf=16
XM2 f2 vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=80 nf=16
XMP1 f1 pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64 nf=16
XMP2 f2 pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=64 nf=16
XMC1 o1 pc f1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=4
XMC2 o2 pc f2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16 nf=4
* Self-biased NMOS cascode mirror load: RSB drops the mirror gate (b) below
* the cascode gate (o1) so the bottom devices stay saturated.
RSB o1 b 6.5k
XMNC1 b o1 c1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMN1 c1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=5 nf=1

* Stage 2
XM6 vout o2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=48 nf=12
XM7 vout pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=160 nf=32

taskTitle: Design a two-stage Miller op amp
circuit:
* Two-stage Miller-compensated CMOS op amp, 1 pF load.
* Complementary input stage (NMOS main + lvt-PMOS auxiliary) so the
* unity-feedback range covers ~0.5..1.3 V at every supply corner.
* Devices: Sky130 1.8 V core MOS (std + lvt) and ideal R/C.
*
* Sizing notes:
*  - Input pair: short L, large W.  A long input device would put its own
*    gate capacitance at the tail node, and that pole sits near the
*    unity-gain frequency and eats phase margin.
*  - Tail device XM5n is deliberately narrow: it must carry the tail
*    current with a small Vgs, which raises the tail node voltage and
*    with it the tail output resistance, which sets CMRR.  Wider tail
*    devices raise the tail current and collapse CMRR.
*  - Second-stage PMOS XM6 is long and moderate width.  L6 raises its
*    output resistance (gain) and W6 sets the gate capacitance it dumps
*    on node X; C1 = Cgs6 + Cgd6 is the dominant non-dominant-pole term,
*    so an over-wide XM6 costs phase margin even though it adds gm.
*  - Mirror PMOS devices are short (L=0.35) to push the mirror pole well
*    above the unity-gain frequency.
*  - RZ moves the Miller right-half-plane zero to the left, adding lead.
*  - All NMOS mirrors share L with reference XM8 so the mirror ratios
*    (hence systematic offset) hold across corners.
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout

* ---- bias generation -------------------------------------------------
XM8  iref  iref  vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=0.5 w=10  nf=1
XM11 auxn  auxn  vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8      l=0.5 w=1.5 nf=1
XM9  auxn  auxn  vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt  l=0.5 w=3.7 nf=1

* ---- main NMOS input pair (active at high common mode) ---------------
XM5n ntailn iref  vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5  w=26  nf=2
XM1n n1n    vinn  ntailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5  w=140 nf=10
XM2n x      vinp  ntailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5  w=140 nf=10
XM3n n1n    n1n   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=21  nf=2
XM4n x      n1n   vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=21  nf=2

* ---- auxiliary PMOS input pair (active at low common mode) -----------
XM5p ntailp auxn  vdd   vdd  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=3.7 nf=1
XM1p n1p    vinn  ntailp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2.2 nf=1
XM2p x      vinp  ntailp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2.2 nf=1
XM3p n1p    n1p   vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1
XM4p x      n1p   vss   vss  sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=6 nf=1

* ---- second stage ----------------------------------------------------
XM6  vout x     vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=200 nf=20
XM7  vout iref  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5  w=110 nf=11

* ---- Miller compensation --------------------------------------------
RZ x nz 870
CC nz vout 0.71p

.ends two_stage_miller_opamp

* Bias: diode-connected NMOS MBA sinks the external 50 uA reference.
* The diode gate node "iref" is the NMOS mirror bias.

* impedance and hence high CMRR).
XMTL tail iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=225 nf=34
* NMOS mirror (50 uA) that feeds the PMOS bias diode.

* Long-L inputs give high intrinsic gain and low DIBL-induced offset.

* branch so the overall amplifier is inverting from vinn.

* Sky130 1.8 V core MOS devices plus ideal R and C.

* 1.62 V / -40 C SS corner, where the lvt-PMOS threshold rises to
* ~0.67 V and a PMOS input-pair stack cannot fit the 0.9 V common mode:
* an NMOS differential pair sits mid-rail comfortably at 0.9 V).

*            mirror load (M3 diode-connected master, M4 slave copy)

*            (M6); the NMOS CS device keeps stage-2 fT high.
* Miller compensation Cc with series nulling resistor Rz (LHP zero).
*
* Polarity: vinn drives M1 (the diode-master side) => vinn is the
* inverting input; vinp drives M2 => non-inverting.  The testbench
* connects vout back to vinn, giving negative feedback.

XMPb bp bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=2

XMNt s iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=32 nf=2
XM1 a vinn s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=60 nf=4
XM2 b vinp s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=60 nf=4

XM4 b a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=16 nf=2

XM6 vout bp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=96 nf=4
XM5 vout b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=200 nf=8

* Two-stage Miller-compensated opamp for Sky130 1.8V core devices.
* NMOS input pair, PMOS mirror load, PMOS output stage, NMOS load.
* Bias: 50u into iref diode NB; N7 and Ntail mirror from the same Vgs.
* Output device runs at high gm with small Cgs (short L, moderate Vgsat)
* to push the non-dominant pole out; Rz cancels the Miller RHP zero.

* --- Bias diode: 50 uA ---
XNB iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
* --- Cascode tail current source ~290 uA: high CM impedance for CMRR.
*     Bottom device mirrors iref and runs in triode as a low-drop pass
*     element; the wide cascode sits well into saturation even at the
*     ss/low-VDD/high-T corner. Cascode gate from an iref-referenced divider
*     (ratio ~0.87) so its overdrive tracks the nfet Vth across corners. ---
XNT1 ntm iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=4
XNT2 ntail vbias ntm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=450 nf=66
RB1 iref vbias 15k
RB2 vbias vss 100k
* --- Input differential pair (vinn on diode side, vinp on output side) ---
XN1 n1 vinn ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=250 nf=36
XN2 na vinp ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=250 nf=36
* --- PMOS current-mirror load ---
XP1 n1 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=28 nf=4
XP2 na n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=28 nf=4

*     W/L set so I6/(W/L)6 = I_P2/(W/L)2: keeps na ~ n1, killing systematic
*     offset and the mirror Vds-mismatch CM feedthrough); NMOS load. ---
XP6 vout na vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=118 nf=17
XN7 vout iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=49 nf=7

RZ nz na 510

taskTitle: Design a two-stage Miller op amp
circuit:
* Two-stage Miller op amp: folded-cascode OTA + common-source output.
* Pins: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* External 50 uA reference flows vdd -> iref.
* Stage 1: NMOS-input folded cascode.  The PMOS fold devices are plain
* current sources; the gain comes from the fast NMOS cascode current
* mirror (no slow PMOS mirror pole).  A small PMOS auxiliary pair
* conducts only at low input common mode to extend the output range.
* Wide-swing cascode gates come from ratioed replica-diode branches, so
* every current is a fixed W/L ratio of the 50 uA reference.
* Stage 2: PMOS common-source (gate at the fold node) with an NMOS
* current-source load.  Miller Cc + nulling resistor compensation.
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ---- 50 uA reference and PMOS mirror gate ----
XNREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=80 nf=4
XNB   nbias iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=4
XPB   nbias nbias vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=40 nf=4
* ---- Cascode bias branch: NMOS cascode gate ncb (~10 uA replica) ----
XPAB    ncb  nbias vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6  nf=1
XNCBCAS ncb  ncb   pab  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6  nf=1
XNCBBOT pab  iref  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1    w=16 nf=2
* ---- Fold-source bias branch: PMOS gate pcb1 (~20 uA) ----
XPBD    pcb1 pcb1  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=24 nf=2
XNBD    pcb1 iref  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1    w=32 nf=2
* ---- Input tails ----
XNT   nt   iref  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=128 nf=8
XPT   pt   nbias vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20  nf=2
* ---- NMOS workhorse input pair (40 uA/device) ----

taskTitle: Design a two-stage Miller op amp
circuit:
* Compensated two-stage Miller op amp, Sky130 1.8 V core devices + ideal R/C.
* Interface: vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout (vinn = inverting, vinp = non-inverting)
* Bias: IREF forces 50 uA from vdd into iref; MREF diode sets VBIASN.
* Tail resistor self-biases the input pair; PMOS mirror loads stage 1;
* PMOS common-source stage 2 with NMOS current-source load;
* Miller compensation Cc with nulling resistor Rn for LHP zero placement.
.param mn_w=300 rtail=1k mp6_w=1010 mp6_l=0.5 mn7_w=96 mn7_l=0.2 cc=0.47p rn=400
.subckt two_stage_miller_opamp vss iref vdd vinn vinp vout
* ---------- bias ----------
XMREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.2 w=10 nf=2
* ---------- input stage (diff pair, PMOS mirror load) ----------
XMN1  n1 vinn vs   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w={mn_w} nf=6
XMN2  g1 vinp vs   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w={mn_w} nf=6
RTAIL vs vss {rtail}
XMP3  vdd n1  n1  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=233 nf=4
XMP4  vdd n1  g1  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=233 nf=4
* ---------- second stage: PMOS CS, NMOS current-source load ----------
XMP6  vdd g1  vout vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={mp6_l} w={mp6_w} nf=4
XMN7  vout iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={mn7_l} w={mn7_w} nf=4
* ---------- Miller compensation with nulling resistor ----------
RR  g1 cn {rn}
CC  cn vout {cc}
.ends two_stage_miller_opamp
